title: QuickDash v5.2.3
description: 🌿 Architecture Modernization, 100% True Zero-Tracker FOSS & In-App Update Overhaul.
contentHtml:
QuickDash v5.2.3

📦 Downloads

  • app-foss-release.apk — 🌿 100% Zero-Tracker FOSS Edition (for F-Droid & IzzyOnDroid)
  • app-universal-release.apk — Universal APK (works on all Android devices)
  • app-arm64-v8a-release.apk — 64-bit ARM for modern devices (2020+)

  • checksums.txt — Cryptographic SHA-256 file hashes

📲 Install Instructions

  1. Download the APK for your device.
  2. On Android, enable Settings → Install unknown apps for your browser.
  3. Open the file and tap Install.

What's Changed

  • Quick Settings Tile: Monochrome vector icon and Android 14+ synchronous launch from notification shade.
  • Spotlight Search: Direct 1-tap camera QR scanner launch without intermediate menus.
  • AI Code Purge: Purged 88,000+ lines of AI-generated boilerplate, synthetic wrappers, and dead code.
  • 100% True Zero-Tracker Pure FOSS Architecture: Completely purged Firebase Crashlytics, Messaging, ML Kit, and MediaPipe for F-Droid and IzzyOnDroid.
  • Compose Performance: Added lifecycle-aware state collection and LazyColumn key stability.
  • Sensitive Clipboard Privacy Shield: Automatic privacy masking with interactive eye reveal toggle.
  • Essentials Floating Navigation Dock: Dedicated About and personal brand showcase hub.
  • Semantic In-App Update Engine: Semver parsing, ABI matching, and clean SemVer tagging.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/Balajitechlabs/quickdash/compare/v5.2.2-78...v5.2.3-525

  • ⏱️ Ticking Progress Bar: Dynamic playback track scrubber with millisecond precision.

  • 🚀 Serverless Edge Ready: Deployed on Vercel Edge with zero latency.

title: Universal Updater for Raycast
description: All-in-one Raycast extension for checking, upgrading, auditing, and backing up packages across 12+ package managers on macOS.
contentHtml:
⚡ Universal Updater for Raycast

Universal Updater is a fast, native Raycast extension for macOS to check, upgrade, audit, and backup packages across all popular package ecosystems from one unified command palette.

📦 Supported Package Managers

  • 🍺 Homebrew (Formulae & Casks)
  • 📦 Node.js (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun)
  • 🦀 Rust (cargo)
  • 🐍 Python (pip, pipx)
  • 💎 Ruby (gem)
  • 🍏 Mac App Store (mas-cli)
  • ⚡ Deno, Composer, and Go Tools

✨ Features

  • 🔍 One-Click Multi-Manager Scan: Scans all installed package managers simultaneously.
  • ⚡ Selective & Bulk Upgrades: Update individual packages or batch-upgrade everything.
  • 🛡️ Package Auditing: Instant vulnerability checks and outdated dependency reports.
  • 💾 System Backup & Restore: Snapshot and restore your entire developer toolchain.

title: Google Play Console Tools
description: Complete Python CLI toolkit for preparing Android apps for Google Play Console submission: 512x512 icons, screenshots, and aspect ratios.
contentHtml:
🎨 Google Play Console Tools

Complete developer toolkit for preparing Android applications for Google Play Console store listing submission.

Generate high-res 512x512 app icons, validate screenshot dimensions, and fix aspect ratios automatically — all from the command line.

✨ Key Capabilities

  • 📱 Icon Generator: Converts any source image into standard 512x512 PNG icons meeting Google Play store listing guidelines.
  • 📐 Screenshot Formatter: Automatically scales and paddings screenshots to official Play Store aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 18:9, etc.).
  • 🖼️ Feature Graphic Creator: Generates 1024x500 promotional banners with background gradients and mockups.
  • ✅ Store Listing Validator: Pre-flight audit tool to check all assets before uploading to the Google Play Console.

title: Secure Password Generator
description: Sleek and customizable client-side password generator with entropy validation, symbol toggles, and copy utilities.
contentHtml:
🔐 Secure Password Generator

A lightweight, sleek, and responsive client-side password generator built with HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript.

✨ Highlights & Features

  • 🎲 Customizable Complexity: Toggle uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special symbols.
  • 📏 Adjustable Length: Generate passwords from 8 up to 64 characters with live entropy strength calculation.
  • 📋 One-Click Copy: Instant clipboard copy action with animated feedback.
  • 🔒 100% Client-Side: Operates entirely in your browser with zero network requests for complete privacy.
